mapper.select: SELECT * FROM telemetry_suite_alarm_config WHERE floor_code = #{floorCode} ORDER BY suite_norm
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO telemetry_suite_alarm_config (floor_code, suite_norm, enabled, temp_min, temp_max, hum_min, hum_max, pressure_min, pressure_max) VALUES (#{floorCode}, #{suiteNorm}, #{enabled}, #{tempMin}, #{tempMax}, #{humMin}, #{humMax}, #{pressureMin}, #{pressureMax}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE floor_code = VALUES(floor_code), enabled = VALUES(enabled), temp_min = VALUES(temp_min), temp_max = VALUES(temp_max), hum_min = VALUES(hum_min), hum_max = VALUES(hum_max), pressure_min = VALUES(pressure_min), pressure_max = VALUES(pressure_max)
mapper.update: UPDATE telemetry_suite_alarm_config SET enabled = #{enabled} WHERE id = #{id}
